mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 200k signals rising household income and consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the housing price index exceeding 5% signals weakening consumer balance sheets and reduced durable-goods demand, which depresses earnings and yields negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where HOUST falls > 5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in industrial production exceeding 2% signals deteriorating manufacturing activity and lower corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where INDPRO falls > 2% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where FEDFUNDS rises > 2.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures exceeding 3% signals weakening demand and lower corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where GDPC1 falls > 3% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals labor market overheating and impending wage inflation, which raises discount rates and yields negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE falls below 4% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
